name: FocusPaw Site Agent
description: Discovery metadata agent for focus-paw.luongnv.com, the FocusPaw landing site. It publishes the site's agentic resources — skills index, MCP server card, API catalog and ARD manifest — for agent-to-agent discovery. FocusPaw is a privacy-first Chrome extension that tracks focus-switching habits; all tracking data stays in local extension storage.

skills.description: Enumerate the agent-readable resources FocusPaw publishes via the ARD manifest at /.well-known/ai-catalog.json.
